name: Test Activity System
description: Simple test activity to validate the activity execution system works correctly

tasks.description: Create a test file with timestamp to verify write operations work

prompt.template:
Create a test file to validate the activity system is working.

**Task**: Write a file at `/tmp/activity-test-{{timestamp}}.txt` with the following content:

```
Activity System Test
====================
Timestamp: {{timestamp}}
Test Message: {{testMessage}}
Status: SUCCESS

This file was created by the test-activity-system activity.
```

**Verification**:
1. Create the directory if it doesn't exist
2. Write the file with the exact content above
3. Verify the file was created successfully
4. Report the full path of the created file

**Use the `write` tool to create the file.**

variables.name: timestamp
variables.description: Timestamp for the test file (defaults to current time)

tasks.description: Verify the test file exists and report success

prompt.template:
Verify the activity system test completed successfully.

**Task**: 
1. Check if the test file `/tmp/activity-test-{{timestamp}}.txt` exists
2. Read the file content to verify it contains the expected data
3. Report the results

**Expected Content**:
- Should contain "Activity System Test"
- Should contain "Status: SUCCESS"
- Should contain "{{testMessage}}"

**Report Format**:
```
✅ Activity System Test Results
================================

File: /tmp/activity-test-{{timestamp}}.txt
Exists: [YES/NO]
Content Valid: [YES/NO]

Test Message Found: {{testMessage}}

🎉 Activity system is working correctly!
```

**Use the `read` and `bash` tools to verify the file.**

variables.name: testMessage
variables.description: Test message from the previous task

metadata.purpose: Test and validate the activity execution system
